summary: An "Ex hi/lo" average over the last N periods now averages within those N ratios instead of reaching further back to replace the pair it dropped.
details: "Simple - 5 Ex hi/lo" takes the last five usable ratios, drops the highest and lowest, and averages the remaining three, matching ResQ and the values ArcRho recalculates on the server.
The Ratios tab, the value saved with the method, the Selected line, and the ratio chart's highlighted points all follow the same rule.
